protocol: Full complete-schedule evaluations; cached elites/current greedy fitness are reused, not re-counted. No incremental scorer. Common cap; actual calls reported.
greedy: Multi-start hardest-event-first coordinate sweep over full random completions; one sweep per restart.
ga: Random initial population; up to population_size offspring evaluated per generation; parent elites plus best children survive.
limitations: Synthetic sample, n=3; illustrative comparison, no statistical or global-optimality claim.
